paper.title: The Impact of Land Use Constraints in Multi-Objective Energy-Noise Wind Farm Layout Optimization

author_assets.paper_implementation: in-house serial C++ NSGA-II with static, dynamic, and death penalty modes, TDM-GCC 4.7.1
author_assets.public_source_status: exact-title, DOI, author, repository, and lab searches located no target source
author_assets.native_data_status: polygon maps, receptor arrays, raw wind matrix, random states, and result fronts unavailable

related_public_formula_source.use: independent ISO 9613 formula cross-check inherited from the H5-validated same-lineage T72 evaluator

paper_source_conflicts.paper: AEP is maximized, while printed penalty equations add positive penalties
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: minimize negative AEP plus positive constraint penalty

paper_source_conflicts.paper: Eq. 9 is dimensionally ambiguous after text extraction and does not freeze polygon-boundary corner handling
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: minimum Euclidean point-to-available-region distance on the deterministic sampled map

paper_source_conflicts.paper: each optimization is carried out five times, while merged C1/C2 tables report ten runs
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: retain C1 and C2 as separate parameterizations and use the platform-required 25 independent seeds per parameterization

missing_information: 225 native random polygon vertices and forbidden identities
octave spectra and complete ISO atmospheric and ground constants
NSGA-II crossover and mutation distribution indices
author random states, trajectories, and machine-readable Pareto fronts
completion_decisions: Reuse the independently H5-validated same-lineage T72 Jensen, wind-state, ISO propagation, land, and NSGA-II components without changing T72 defaults; select a T64 profile for the paper's cubic power and constant noise source.
Use deterministic similar-area jittered-Voronoi maps and one receptor at each forbidden seed.
Use the cited Kusiak direction probabilities and Weibull scales to reconstruct 24 directions by 43 speed bins.
Use standard full Jensen deficit and the pinned-PyWake-checked ISO constants frozen by T72.
Use Deb-standard eta_c=eta_m=20 and offspring size equal to population.
Use counter-keyed feasible sequential-within-layout construction and parallelize layouts across the population.
A death rejection consumes the infeasible full layout evaluation plus one full evaluation of its feasible replacement.
Use four deterministic map variants for the missing native uniformity arrays.
Exclude paper comparison baselines; static, dynamic, and death modes are all target methods.

domain.map_generator: 15 by 15 jittered seed lattice and sampled Voronoi cells
domain.receptor_semantics: one receptor at the generating seed of every forbidden reconstructed polygon

objectives_and_constraints.objectives: maximize Jensen/RSS annual energy and minimize ISO-9613 maximum expected receptor A-weighted SPL
objectives_and_constraints.regulatory: every turbine must lie outside all forbidden reconstructed polygons
objectives_and_constraints.uniformity_metric: centered L2 discrepancy of normalized forbidden-polygon centers

nsga2.convergence: rank-one crowding-distance variance below 0.005 for the last 100 generations

static: C1=1e4 for both objectives and both constraints
C2=4e4 for both objectives and both constraints
constraint_modes.death: discard each infeasible layout after its physical evaluation and physically evaluate a new feasible layout

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete AEP, maximum-SPL, and constraint evaluation of one physical layout
physical_fes_ledger.variation_and_dominance: do not consume physical wind-farm FES
physical_fes_ledger.terminal_partial_work: unless the paper convergence criterion stops the run first, the final offspring prefix and any permitted death replacement exactly fill the requested budget

hpc_execution.single_run: one persistent worker team parallelizes feasible population construction, physical evaluation, offspring variation, death replacement, and dominance construction
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: counter-keyed random events, fixed-index writes, stable ranks, and ordered environmental selection preserve one/all-worker scientific identity
hpc_execution.formal_resource_rule: one optimization process owns every Waffle CPU core; configurations and 25 seeds execute sequentially without nested oversubscription
hpc_execution.timings: physical evaluator, algorithm-only, and end-to-end wall times are reported separately

claim_boundary: academic flexible paper/lineage reconstruction of all target constraint modes and paper problem roles; not author code, native maps, native wind array, original random stream, raw fronts, or exact numerical replay
